commander_identity.mechanical_plan: Tresserhorn's Lord, Returned is a five-mana 10/4 indestructible Zombie Warrior: three life, giving each opponent three cards and sacrificing three other creatures are a real cast/ETB cost; once on battlefield each own creature sacrifice draws a card. Prebuild cheap bodies and use Crawler/Altar, sacrifice payoffs and real attack pressure.
commander_identity.natural_ceiling: Power Bracket 4 — Optimized sacrifice/aristocrats with a 10-power resilient commander, finite library/life limits and a real three-creature entry constraint; no proven statistical cEDH or guaranteed infinite wins.
commander_identity.anti_homogenization: Retain the unique three-sacrifice ETB setup, commander-driven creature-sacrifice draws and zombie recursion rather than adding unrelated Grixis Oracle/Breach combo packages. Premium free counters are only selected as a practical protection tradeoff.

whole_deck_audit.roles_and_overlaps: All 99 prior noncommander physical cards were audited from Oct15; prepared fodder producers, death/draw loops, token and free outlets, recursive Zombies, enchantment/sweepers, commander protection, color pips, 10-power attack finish and tapland costs challenged. A separate exact-source 100/94-name source and 7 real substitutions preserve the core and add card-specific interaction; no existing card is arbitrarily removed to reach seven swaps.
whole_deck_audit.mana_base_and_curve: The exact final 100 has 32 front-face lands plus Boggart Trawler // Boggart Bog and Agadeem's Awakening // Agadeem, the Undercrypt as land MDFCs; one Swamp replaces with tapped-or-3-life modal black land. This costs early basic reliability against late graveyard recursion. Lord needs UBR + two generic with available three creature fodder, not merely five mana.
whole_deck_audit.interaction_resilience: Deflecting Swat can redirect one legally targetable effect with commander active, not mass destruction. Fierce Guardianship is free only if Lord is controlled and cannot stop creature spells; original Not of This World protects 7+ power-targeted Lord. Meathook can kill own indestructible 10/4 at X=4 or greater. Fodder and graveyard hate remain vulnerabilities.

weakest_slots.weakness: Full-99 incumbent challenge: Dark Ritual supplies a real original plan role, but the proposed Genesis Chamber directly increases commander sacrifice fodder, protection or spell-land flexibility at a known cost.
weakest_slots.reasoning: Two-mana Genesis Chamber pays in actual Myr creature fodder from subsequent nontoken creature casts, including independent sacrifice bodies before Lord arrives. Adversarial cost: Its symmetric triggers grant opponents Myr and consume a deck slot once used for a one-shot BBB ritual.

weakest_slots.weakness: Full-99 incumbent challenge: Endrek Sahr, Master Breeder supplies a real original plan role, but the proposed Sengir Autocrat directly increases commander sacrifice fodder, protection or spell-land flexibility at a known cost.
weakest_slots.reasoning: Four-mana Autocrat creates three Serfs immediately, supporting a five-mana Lord next turn with three real creature sacrifices. Adversarial cost: Autocrat leaving exiles all Serfs; five-mana Endrek's later creature casts can yield more persistent Thrulls and higher repeatable ceiling.

weakest_slots.weakness: Full-99 incumbent challenge: Village Rites supplies a real original plan role, but the proposed Deflecting Swat directly increases commander sacrifice fodder, protection or spell-land flexibility at a known cost.
weakest_slots.reasoning: Zero mana to redirect a legal target when Lord is controlled increases survival and can disrupt enemy targeting at the five-mana deployment turn. Adversarial cost: Can be three-mana dead weight precommander and cannot retarget spells without another legal target; loses one-mana creature-for-two-card draw.

weakest_slots.weakness: Full-99 incumbent challenge: Stubborn Denial supplies a real original plan role, but the proposed Fierce Guardianship directly increases commander sacrifice fodder, protection or spell-land flexibility at a known cost.
weakest_slots.reasoning: Free hard noncreature counter while Lord is on battlefield defends a nearly tapped-out commander-centric turn. Adversarial cost: Costs three mana without commander versus one-blue Stubborn Denial; a generic premium spell risks homogenizing the native sacrifice package.

weakest_slots.weakness: Full-99 incumbent challenge: Tempt with Vengeance supplies a real original plan role, but the proposed Song of Totentanz directly increases commander sacrifice fodder, protection or spell-land flexibility at a known cost.
weakest_slots.reasoning: Generates exactly X Rat creatures without opponent cooperation and grants haste to creatures already controlled to accelerate a Lord's attack after casting. Adversarial cost: Generated Rats cannot block; haste applies only to creatures already controlled at resolution and forfeits sometimes-extra Tempt tokens.

weakest_slots.weakness: Full-99 incumbent challenge: Blasphemous Edict supplies a real original plan role, but the proposed The Meathook Massacre directly increases commander sacrifice fodder, protection or spell-land flexibility at a known cost.
weakest_slots.reasoning: Scalable toughness reduction plus persistent creature-death drain and opponent-death lifegain combine board cleanup with the Lord sacrifice engine. Adversarial cost: X at least four kills the 10/4 indestructible Lord via zero toughness; expensive large sweeps and loses cheap wide-board edict.

weakest_slots.weakness: Full-99 incumbent challenge: Swamp supplies a real original plan role, but the proposed Agadeem's Awakening // Agadeem, the Undercrypt directly increases commander sacrifice fodder, protection or spell-land flexibility at a known cost.
weakest_slots.reasoning: Spell-land gives black mana as a land or returns differently costed sacrifice creatures late for another Lord ETB payment. Adversarial cost: Land face costs three life for untapped use, otherwise enters tapped; one fewer true basic Swamp with printed mana symbol reliability.

weakest_slots.weakness: Retained early Zombie discount was challenged for additional death-triggering Eldrazi Spawn.
weakest_slots.reasoning: Familiar consistently reduces generic Lord cost and enables Gravecrawler; Pawn only triggers on nontoken death and loses the two-mana Zombie body.

weakest_slots.weakness: A basic untapped red source challenged by a modal instant-power finisher.
weakest_slots.reasoning: An instant ten-damage sacrifice channel is attractive, but the tapped land and sacrificing Lord can trade away repeatable draw and the attack engine.

weakest_slots.weakness: Token bank scales on many draws from Lord at low mana investment.
weakest_slots.reasoning: Sifter makes Spawn on nontoken creature death only, so it misses numerous actual creature-token sacrifices that support Lord's triggers.

weakest_slots.weakness: Four-player Witch provides repeated sacrifice leverage and four bodies.
weakest_slots.reasoning: Chief supplies only three bodies and no removal/outlet; it cannot displace the Witch's commander-setup role.

whole_deck_audit.current_baseline_strength: The exact owner-approved October 15 100 already had coherent Bracket 4 Zombie/Altar/Plumb and Lord attack synergies; the historical Pass C KEEP judged that old source without full Phase B, not this new 100. It was never a wrong list.
whole_deck_audit.candidate_pool_scope: At least fourteen material add alternatives across live commander-specific EDHREC Top/High Lift, outside-ranked search and other meaningful challenged slots; complete simultaneous Alt5 and Alt9 exact 100s, 99-slot role audit and four named start-state side-by-side traces were published, with clear unresolved strategic edges.
whole_deck_audit.off_ranked_search_conclusion: OFF-RANKING challenge of Genesis Chamber, Kazuul's Fury, Dread Return, Chthonian Nightmare and Tombstone Stairwell against their real cuts; exact high-count Alt9 exposes tapped-land and narrower token-death consequences, not a rationale to manufacture swaps.

low_swap_heightened_audit.off_ranked_opportunities: OFF-RANKED Genesis Chamber supplies symmetric two-mana creature fodder, The Meathook Massacre changes anti-indestructible sweeps, Kazuul's Fury offers ten-power sacrifice damage but costs mana-base reliability, and Chthonian Nightmare offers energy-limited recursion; their actual alternatives are compared against protected core.

multi_slot_packages.result_and_rationale: Complete conservative Alt5 exact100, raw SHA a57de231... preserves Endrek repeatable Thrulls and precommander one-black Village Rites draw. It loses Rev1's immediate four-mana Autocrat three Serfs and commander-active Swat protection; neither option strictly dominates all starts.

Complete aggressive Alt9 exact100, raw SHA 5d2991dd..., introduces tapped Kazuul land and non-token-only Pawn Spawn, sacrificing basic Mountain and Familiar zombie discount. More swaps reduce early mana reliability and fail to improve the many token-sacrifice lines.

low_swap_heightened_audit.alternate_cuts_for_prior_holds: Chittering Witch versus Beetleback Chief remains a strong real four-body source with a sacrifice outlet, Chasm Skulker versus Sifter creates a large draw-fueled token bank, and Kher Keep land bodies are retained over another tapped red MDFC.
low_swap_heightened_audit.strongest_argument_against_baseline: The previously approved source already maintains reliable one-black Village Rites, BBB ritual burst and repeated Endrek Thrulls without opponents getting Genesis Chamber Myr. These are real incumbent strengths that Rev1 trades for immediate setup and commander protection.
low_swap_heightened_audit.evidence_based_answer: The selected exact seven improves bounded immediate Lord fodder setup when Autocrat lands at four, repeats cheap Chamber bodies as non-token creatures enter, and protects Lord after it resolves. It does not prove wins over Alt5; particular opening hands favor each, and approval is a strategic preference under explicitly acknowledged limitations.

final_candidate.deckwide_reconciliation: Owner-approved exact 100 raw, 94 distinct, three basic Islands, three basic Mountains, three Swamps (one replaced), 32 printed lands plus two playable land MDFCs, 7 one-for-one changes; immutable historical Oct15 approved source untouched.

open_ended_optimization_audit.remaining_99_review: After the owner-selected seven, re-evaluated retained low-curve Zombie loop pieces, Chittering Witch four bodies and sacrifice outlet, Chasm Skulker draw-fueled token bank, Kher Keep repeated tokens, Nightscape Familiar as a Zombie/cost reducer, and fixed basic red Mountain. Challenged extra off-ranking cards against these exact roles and the earlier seven choices, with ongoing opponent-benefit and removal tests. The selected 100 is a coherent quality judgment but not a full tested local optimum.

post_floor_challenges.tradeoff: Pawn can make Spawn on nontoken creature death, but the many token sacrifices under Lord yield zero triggers; Familiar reduces Lord generic mana by one and remains a Gravecrawler-enabling Zombie.
A ten-power damage channel has utility, but the instant requires sacrificing expensive Lord and the land face always enters tapped, losing early reliable red mana.
Skulker grows and turns Lord draw into many Squid sacrifice creatures, while Sifter only triggers on nontoken death and misses the wider token-engine action.

larger_swap_packages.case_for_extra_swaps: Two more real slots supply a ten-power instant sacrifice-to-damage finisher and Spawn tokens after nontoken creature death, a plausible higher-card-swap aggression package.
larger_swap_packages.why_not_selected: Alt9 gives up untapped red Mountain and cheap Zombie/cost-reducing Familiar, while most Lord engine sacrifices are tokens that never trigger Pawn, weakening actual source-paid commander turns.

open_ended_optimization_audit.quality_based_stop_reason: The actual seven were not selected to hit a quota: Genesis Chamber and Sengir directly address three-body readiness; free commander-active counters and modal land provide defined improvements. After challenging retained Zombie discount, land reliability, draw-token engines and additional recursion options, Alt9 imposes tapped-land and narrow Spawn risks. Alt5 remains a different strategic preference, not a demonstrably inferior win-rate list. No full M6 Phase B or randomized multiplayer result claimed.
